title: orchestrated-eval-gateway-for-segmented-canaries
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an Eval Gateway service and orchestration hooks that attach cohort-specific anchor prompt sets, compute multi-metric scorecards in realtime, and gate/auto-quarantine canaries and split experiments based on configurable hysteresis and confidence thresholds.
notes: Purpose: prevent subtle quality regressions when flipping model variants by evaluating live traffic against curated anchor sets per customer cohort.
This affixes gated decisions to observable scorecards (latency, token-penalty-adjusted-quality, semantic-similarity, hallucination-rate proxies) rather than single aggregated signals.
We will support both synchronous gating for small-percentage canaries and asynchronous monitoring with weighted rollbacks for larger traffic allocations.
comments: 2026-01-22 — Initial spike complete: prototype Eval Gateway accepts a request snapshot and returns per-probe metrics. Locally validated against 3 anchor sets (docs, code, conversational). — Samir

2026-02-03 — Design review with PM/Design: accepted cohort sampling model and storage format for anchor prompts (compact fingerprint + canonical examples). Action: add schema versioning and signed probe bundles. — Ava

2026-02-17 — Perf notes: gateway CPU-bound at high concurrency; moving heavy embedding work to async workers and caching recent probe embeddings in Redis. Trade-off: slight delay in eval signal vs. lower p95 latency for gated canaries.

2026-02-28 — Integration plan: wiring into rollout conductor: canary lifecycle will send candidate traffic via 'siphon' to shadow variant and to Eval Gateway; gating decisions emitted as policy events. Next: PR for policy DSL. — Samir

2026-03-09 — QA: ran a staged A/B with synthetic probe injection (1000 probes) and exercised adaptive hysteresis. Observed false positive rate 0.8% on semantic-similarity metric; tuning thresholds lowered FP at cost of detection delay (~2 minutes).
acceptance_criteria: Eval Gateway can attach the correct anchor set for at least 5 customer cohorts and return a scorecard JSON (stable schema v1) within configured SLA (p50 < 120ms for cached probes, p95 < 350ms for warm path)
Rollout Conductor can use Eval events to automatically reduce canary weight or trigger quarantine when multi-metric policies exceed thresholds for configurable hysteresis windows
Dashboard exposes per-cohort scorecard trends and a 'why-rollback' forensic view linked to probe examples and diffed responses
System supports secure probe bundles (signed, versioned) and RBAC controls for who can modify anchor sets
End-to-end tests for synthetic probe injection must produce reproducible regression detections and a false-positive rate below 1.5% on our validation harness
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Eval Gateway adds latency to canaries if run inline. Mitigation: default to asynchronous gating for >5% traffic; provide optional inline mode for 0-1% canaries.
Risk: Overfitting to anchor sets and high false positive rollbacks. Mitigation: use stratified anchor sets and weighted scoring with minimum sample counts before action.
Risk: Storage and drift of anchor prompts. Mitigation: scheduled refresh jobs and signature checks; audit logs + versioned bundles.
